costs.stress: spread x2, x3 on the selected trials
costs.swap: spec-probe swap, charges only, x3 Wednesday

hypothesis: Threshold sensitivity of VEI, the OFI proxy ratio (incl. the proposed 3.0 = 300%) and the quote-burst percentile as single add-ons
leakage_rules: features from completed TF bars only (closed-bar rule); certified with nexa_causality
TF bars built only from M1 rows inside their interval
trailing statistics use strictly prior bars

periods_utc.semantics: half-open UTC; VAL is SEEN data (not clean OOS); OOS is prospective

purge_embargo.rule: entry >= start + embargo (not DEV); signal + max_label <= end; exit < end

tests.selection_rule: per (experiment, claim, symbol): highest VAL one-sided 95% stationary-bootstrap lower bound of net R among trials with >= 30 VAL trades; ties -> trial_id
